scope: Research audit; no competition eligibility certification and no biological outcome

primary.estimator: shrunk_endpoint_recentering; exact implementation and real normalization contract pending
primary.comparator: endpoint_mixture; matched preprocessing, training-derived strata and endpoint sampling
primary.permissible_conditional_claim: Predictive usefulness of this frozen recentering transformation over endpoint mixture on this released-stage proxy only
primary.attribution_excluded: Neither isolated composition/state attribution nor causal dynamics: both estimators use endpoint conditional expression, and recentering changes between-endpoint variance
primary.persistence: secondary comparator; no superiority claim without separate preregistration
primary.other_tasks: secondary or exploratory; no official interpolation, extrapolation or unseen-gene generalization claim

freeze_gate.truth_fitted_evaluator_operations: Evaluation only; unavailable for predictor fitting or subsequent confirmatory selection
freeze_gate.policy: Resolve required fields for the requested analysis mode before target access. Nulls never imply defaults. Numerical guardrail margins and simultaneous procedures are conditionally required only for a registered noninferiority claim. Descriptive secondary analyses do not require them. Access enforcement is specified only, not implemented or tested.

requires: eligible real samples and exact split manifest
verified annotation and measured-space normalization contracts
specified expression scorer and sampling procedure
actual access-enforcement implementation and tests before execution
not_required: biological replication sufficient for population inference
descriptive_expression.permitted_scope: Descriptive D and conditional sampling/refit sensitivity, with available embryo identities and dependence limitations reported

requires: untouched exact assessment and completed immutable selection lock
independent embryo/litter/batch manifest and sufficient replication
prespecified population weighting and inferential procedure
confirmatory_expression.conditional_requirements: eta_j and simultaneous_guardrail_claim_method required only if noninferiority/no-degradation claim registered
confirmatory_expression.permitted_scope: Frozen recentering-versus-mixture contrast on the stated proxy; no decomposition or generalization claim

requires: verified physical units and comparable capture coverage
predeclared pooled or per-embryo spatial estimand
specified spatial scorer and neighborhood construction
spatial.if_unavailable: Copied donor coordinates are serialization placeholders only; exclude pooled anatomical, joint-distribution and neighborhood interpretation. Never register using E7.25 truth.

success_rule.primary: Prespecified one-sided lower confidence bound for across-independent-embryo mean D exceeds delta_star > 0
success_rule.secondary_analysis_mode: descriptive; no noninferiority or no-degradation claim registered
success_rule.guardrail_field_applicability_now: not_applicable to descriptive secondary analysis; numerical inputs remain null
success_rule.guardrails_if_future_claim_registered: Each prespecified simultaneous upper bound for deterioration-oriented G_j is below eta_j; nonsignificance is insufficient. Requires new preregistration before untouched assessment access.
success_rule.if_guardrails_not_registered: Report components descriptively and drop no-degradation claim
success_rule.planning: Record mu_A > delta_star separately; distance to threshold is mu_A - delta_star, with small-sample and litter/batch sensitivity
success_rule.insufficient_data: No confirmatory inference; descriptive D and conditional sampling/refit variability only

data_roles.fitting: Eligible E6.75/E8.0 samples; fit normalization, states, weights and predictor without E7.25 values
data_roles.selection: Training-only evidence or separately eligible development samples disjoint from assessment; freeze estimator and hyperparameters before access
data_roles.assessment: Exact manifest-locked independent E7.25 embryos; score locked predictions once under frozen procedure
data_roles.exploration: After assessment, residuals may inform research hypotheses; any resulting model requires fresh eligible untouched assessment
data_roles.legacy_proxy: Neurl IPS 2026/agent_orchestrator.py::_proxy_score is explicitly not an implementation of this plan

target_access_policy.future_operational_verification: Implement durable ledger and immutable model/data/config hashes; actually call repeat-assessment, change-lock and excluded-artifact retrieval operations and verify refusal. Current illustrative events and boolean assertions do not test enforcement.
target_access_policy.before_first_access: Assess only if freeze gate passed and target untouched
target_access_policy.on_assessment_access: Irrevocably mark this assessment consumed; completion cannot reset status
target_access_policy.on_residual_access_or_model_change: Mark follow-up exploratory; original target cannot assess revised model confirmatorily
target_access_policy.reuse_prohibition: No E7.25 residual-guided architecture, prior, preprocessing or hyperparameter selection followed by confirmatory reuse of the same E7.25 assessment

synthetic_ledger_policy_illustration.label: Hand-written policy illustration only; no evaluator call, actual refusal, durable ledger, isolated launch or biological target access occurred

assess locked model on fictional target A
events.decision: record hypothetical assessment; no outcome supplied

events.action: inspect fictional target A residual and change architecture
illustrate request for confirmatory assessment of revised model on fictional target A
